profile.headline: Flight Software Engineer @ Odyssey | TAMU ‘24
profile.summary:
I enjoy anything at the intersection of computers and space. My primary focus is embedded software development, working on flight software projects, owning the entire computing stack. My joy comes from leading a product feature from conception to full integration.

Computer Engineer from Texas A&M University with a minor in Mathematics, an ABET accredited program that was a mix of electrical engineering and computer science to learn the in’s and out’s of theoretical and practical computation, which I apply to real-time systems.

Programming Languages: C, C++, Python, Assembly (ARM), Bash
Frameworks: ROS2, Unix, FreeRTOS, Linux
Tools: Git, Visual Studio Code, Vim, Microsoft Suite, Xilinx Vitis, Docker, Jenkins, CMake, GNU tools
Teamwork: SCRUM, Agile, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, BitBucket, Confluence)

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer
positions.description: Writing and testing Class A human-rated software for safety-critical spaceflight computers.

positions.title: Senior Instructor
positions.description:
Taught programming fundamentals through hands-on projects in robotics and web development.
Tailored curriculum around student schedules and learning disabilities.
Built strong client relations with parents providing updates and addressing individual student needs.
